description: Header timing offset (record bits 104-114, little-endian: byte 13 plus the low 3 bits of byte 14) against the record's arrival time. Arrival residual = time of the record's first CAN frame minus a linear fit on the record clock code (bytes 1-4); the residual sd is the arrival jitter. Computed on the three bundled CAN samples by decoding the 0x80 records with ars510.transport.Id80RecordAssembler.
reading: The field tracks the record's arrival offset at about 0.9-1.0 ms per count (level correlation 0.94-0.96, record-to-record change correlation 0.98-0.99) on all three bundled drives; the physical meaning (the time between the radar's measurement and the start of transmission) is the reading the numbers support.
confidence: likely (three drives of one car, one radar firmware)
